name: Plant MitoCarta & Inter-Organellar Atlas
description: Cross-compartment ontology, four digital doubles (Mitochondrion, Chloroplast, Nucleus, Plasma Membrane), retrograde signaling circuits, and mammalian MitoCarta comparative synthesis.

evidence_tiers.label: Demonstrated Empirical (Plant)
evidence_tiers.definition: Direct empirical measurement of the entity's presence, activity, flux, or translocation in Arabidopsis thaliana. Requires at least one resolved DOI in evidence.

evidence_tiers.label: Inferred from Pathway/Process (Plant)
evidence_tiers.definition: Demonstrated for the containing multi-protein complex, organellar fraction, or metabolic pathway in plants, but not isolated directly to this single node. Requires at least one resolved DOI in evidence.

evidence_tiers.label: Orthology-Inferred (Mammalian/Yeast)
evidence_tiers.definition: Inferred from human or mouse Broad MitoCarta 3.0 or yeast homologs with no direct plant biochemical assay. A cross-species inference.

evidence_tiers.label: Mechanistic Hypothesis / Computational Prediction
evidence_tiers.definition: Hypothesized physical route, predicted membrane contact site, candidate retrograde messenger, or SUBAcon computational prediction.

evidence_tiers.label: Anatomical & Topological Context
evidence_tiers.definition: Structural or spatial context (membranes, cristae, pores, compartments). No quantum or biochemical claim made on this node.

maps.title: Plant Mitochondrial Electron Transport and Oxidative Phosphorylation
maps.subtitle: Conserved respiratory Complexes I–V integrated with plant-specific bypasses (AOX, Type II NDHs, and the Complex I Carbonic Anhydrase domain).

maps.title: Chloroplast Light Reactions, Carbon Fixation, and Retrograde Origins
maps.subtitle: Thylakoid electron transport coupled to RuBisCO carbon/oxygen fixation and the initiation of plastid retrograde messengers.

maps.title: Nuclear Transcriptional Command and Organelle Reprogramming
maps.subtitle: The nuclear convergence hub where mitochondrial and plastid retrograde signals reprogram the genome to adjust bioenergetics.

maps.title: Plasma Membrane Perception, Gravity Sensing, and Systemic Waves
maps.subtitle: Cell surface mechanical and gravity sensing driving calcium spikes and apoplastic ROS waves that propagate inward to mitochondria and chloroplasts.

maps.title: The Mitochondrial Retrograde Response (MRR) Cascade
maps.subtitle: From cristae respiratory stress to nuclear MDRE promoter activation via the rhomboid protease-cleaved ANAC017/013 transcription factor axis.

maps.title: The Plastid-to-Nucleus Retrograde Response (PRR) Circuits
maps.subtitle: Four parallel communication channels conveying chloroplast operational state, pigment biosynthesis, and redox stress to the nucleus.

maps.title: The 3-Organelle Photorespiratory Metabolic Loop
maps.subtitle: The obligatory metabolic partnership of Chloroplasts, Peroxisomes, and Mitochondria recycling 2-phosphoglycolate produced by RuBisCO oxygenation.

maps.title: Organelle Membrane Contact Sites (MCS) and Stromule-Nuclear Docking
maps.subtitle: Non-vesicular lipid and ion exchange across physical organellar contact sites, and dynamic chloroplast stromule docking directly onto the nuclear envelope.

maps.title: Cross-Kingdom Synteny: Broad MitoCarta 3.0 vs Plant Mitochondrial Proteome
maps.subtitle: Systematic alignment of conserved catalytic bioenergetics with plant-specific metabolic innovations, bypasses, and dual-targeted endosymbiotic machinery.

maps.title: Integrated Multi-Organelle Digital Double Atlas
maps.subtitle: The unified plant cell: Mitochondrion, Chloroplast, Nucleus, and Plasma Membrane bound by retrograde signaling, metabolic shuttles, and systemic waves.
